//: The end-to-end layer, which belongs to no package: it drives the built artefacts of two apps and the API at once, so it sits at the root and needs a program of its own. Type-aware ESLint maps each file to its nearest tsconfig, and without this one the specs and the Playwright config are the only .ts files in the repository outside every program - which ESLint reports as a parsing error rather than skipping.
